# GW8 Base Signal Agent API
> Monetized AI Trading Signal Endpoint on Base Mainnet.

## Service Specs
- Network: Base Mainnet (Chain ID 8453)
- Token Contract: 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913 (USDC)
- Pay To Wallet: 0xB4527dccaC81eB73d4988A51a4cb1FBBF2C3CaBd
- Protocol: x402 Micropayments (Coinbase CDP / EIP-3009)
- Price: 0.05 USDC (50000 atomic units)

## Primary Endpoint
### [POST /api/agent](https://micro-saas-agent.onrender.com/api/agent)
- Primary Handshake: Headers `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` or `X-PAYMENT`
- Fallback Header: `X-Payment-Tx`
- Description: Returns sub-minute RSI(14), Bollinger Bands, momentum classification, and confidence scoring for BTC/USD, ONDO/USD, and XPR/USD.
- Supported Enum Signals:
  - `OVERSOLD_ACCUMULATION_ZONE`
  - `OVERBOUGHT_DISTRIBUTION_ZONE`
  - `BULLISH_MOMENTUM_BUILD`
  - `BEARISH_MOMENTUM_BUILD`
  - `NEUTRAL_CONSOLIDATION`

## Discovery & Manifests
- [x402 Manifest](https://micro-saas-agent.onrender.com/.well-known/x402.json): Machine-readable payment schema for CDP Facilitator and Bazaar.
